name: Vanilla 2D Gaussian Splatting Rendering
definition: Renders a scene using 2D Gaussian primitives, computing RGB, alpha, normals, and depth maps via a custom rasterizer.
summary: Vanilla 2D Gaussian Splatting Rendering projects 3D-aware 2D primitives to produce RGB, alpha, depth, and normal maps using standard volumetric alpha blending without pre-computed 3D covariance matrices.
